decks.notes: The deck revolves around exploiting the synergy between Lotus Field and cards that allow for untapping it, such as Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands. By utilizing these combo pieces, the deck aims to generate large amounts of mana quickly to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The inclusion of cards like Pore Over the Pages and Dig Through Time provide card selection and digging to find the combo pieces needed for the deck to function efficiently. Overall, the deck focuses on setting up a game-winning combo as quickly and consistently as possible.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana production through devotion to green, with creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. This allows for the quick deployment of powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a constant stream of big creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn, while also utilizing cards like Storm the Festival to maintain board presence. The inclusion of lands like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Lair of the Hydra further enhances the deck's devotion strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to gain incremental advantages and outvalue opponents. By combining cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven, the deck can deal damage to opponents while generating extra value from sacrificing creatures. Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push help control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes a strong removal suite with Thoughtseize and Deadly Dispute. The mana base is built around black and red dual lands, allowing for consistent early plays and powerful late-game threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays through efficient removal spells like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Go for the Throat, along with powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. In addition, the deck has a mix of lands that provide both color fixing and utility, such as Castle Locthwain and Hive of the Eye Tyrant. With a strong curve and multiple ways to apply pressure, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly.

The focus of this deck is to control the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage provided by Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant board presence with threats like Shark Typhoon and Hall of Storm Giants, while using cards like Memory Deluge and Omen of the Sea to dig for more answers. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents for extra card advantage and tempo.

This deck focuses on utilizing spells to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, allowing for a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck includes a variety of low-cost spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to control the board while also fueling the graveyard for Phoenix recursion. Cards like Treasure Cruise and Pieces of the Puzzle help dig for key pieces while Thing in the Ice provides a potential alternate win condition. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass offers an additional powerful finisher option for the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with spells to enable the recursion of Arclight Phoenix. It utilizes spells like Opt, Treasure Cruise, and Pieces of the Puzzle to draw cards and fill the graveyard, while also incorporating cards like Thing in the Ice and Lightning Axe for removal and disruption. The goal is to quickly bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to deal damage and overwhelm the opponent, while also maintaining a level of control with counterspells like Spell Pierce and disruption with cards like Fiery Impulse.

This deck focuses on fast, aggressive gameplay by swarming the board with low-cost creatures like Burning-Tree Emissary and Fanatical Firebrand, then finishing off the opponent with powerful damage-dealing cards like Fanatic of Mogis and Torbran, Thane of Red Fell. The deck also includes cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Leyline of Combustion to punish opponents for playing spells, along with Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Chandra, Dressed to Kill for additional burn and card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cheap spells and card draw to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries, in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal consistent damage to the opponent. The deck focuses on aggressive plays and tempo manipulation, using cards like Thing in the Ice to control the board while setting up for big turns with Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass. The inclusion of powerful lands like Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional advantages in closing out games quickly.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to control the board with counterspells, removal, and board wipes like Supreme Verdict while generating card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck also aims to protect its threats with cards like Portable Hole and Dovin's Veto while maintaining tempo with cards like Shark Typhoon and Spell Pierce. Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful finisher, Farewell and The Wandering Emperor offer recursion, and Make Disappear and Demolition Field provide additional removal options. Overall, the deck focuses on control and resource management to outlast and outvalue opponents.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, removal, and card advantage to outlast the opponent. The addition of Yorion as a companion allows for extra value by blinking permanents for added advantage. The deck aims to stabilize the board with cards like Supreme Verdict and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, while maintaining card advantage with Omen of the Sea and Memory Deluge. With a mix of control elements and win conditions like Shark Typhoon, the deck aims to grind out the opponent and secure victory through incremental advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana through green devotion cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while also utilizing cards like Oath of Nissa and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to help fix mana and draw cards. The deck aims to flood the board with powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn, while using Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt opponents and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect key spells. Storm the Festival helps to find key creatures, while Lair of the Hydra provides additional threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly in order to cast powerful spells and combo off. By ramping into Lotus Field with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Voyaging Satyr, the deck can then use cards like Hidden Strings and Thespian's Stage to untap Lotus Field and generate even more mana. The deck also includes ways to search for key combo pieces like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience to establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm opponents with powerful spells and abilities.
